fields.description_1: There were good pieces of information on driving schools at SoDrive, but the message should have been more structured and prioritized. People should be able to scan through and understand what's in it for them, and how to proceed next easily. The wording should not be generic either.
fields.description_2: As a result, I have written the text anew in such a way that each section of the page provides an answer to one specific visitor's question. In this way, my rewritten case study provides information about the driving school job opportunities in simple language and shows how their advantages will affect you in your decisions.

fields.description_1: Autoinkoopatlas needed a website that encouraged visitors to offer their vehicle for sale online. People are often cautious because they are unsure about value, safety, timing, and what happens after they share their details. The website therefore had to explain the full process clearly and build trust from the start.
fields.description_2: I created a conversion-focused website that guides visitors from vehicle information to an inquiry form. The site explains what to do, why it matters, and what happens next in simple sections. This makes offering a car feel straightforward, transparent, and easy to complete.

fields.description_1: Boekhoudsnel needed a clearer finance page because visitors had to understand the offer before making contact. The existing story needed stronger order, more specific wording, and fewer general lines. People comparing options needed quick context, visible next steps, and enough practical detail to decide whether to continue. Before contact mattered.
fields.description_2: I rebuilt the page around clearer sections, direct English copy, and practical WordPress content blocks. The structure shows what the work involves, why it matters, and how visitors can respond. Stronger scanning, calmer wording, and focused contact routes help people compare the project and make decisions with confidence. It mattered.

fields.description_1: Regarding the energy page of Voltworks, there was a need to avoid any delay in action when the visitor was considering enquiring. The visitor would already be making comparisons, so there was a need to explain clearly what the company could do, the details involved, and what the next step was.
fields.description_2: I have developed a streamlined approach to navigating the site through more concise headers and content fields in WordPress, as well as the proper wording for their projects. The design will provide better representation for Voltworks, while the visitor will be able to browse their work, discern its value, and proceed towards contacting them.

fields.description_1: Jouwgroenteboer needed a clearer ecommerce page, so visitors could understand the offer before contacting or taking action. The existing story needed more structure, more precise wording and a clearer route forward for people comparing options online.
fields.description_2: I restructured the site into logical sections using plain English and WordPress content blocks. The new flow explains the offer, why it matters and what visitors can do next. Better scanning, clearer language and a defined contact path help people evaluate the project with confidence.

fields.description_2: I improved the readability of the installation story with a stronger opening, clearer service sections and practical information that supports the next step. The WordPress layout makes the page easy to scan, while the copy gives visitors enough context to act confidently.

fields.description_1: Envolt needed an electrical services page with a clearer structure and stronger focus. Visitors had to understand the offer quickly, see the practical value and know how to take the next step. The copy also needed to sound more specific and less interchangeable.
fields.description_2: I reorganised the page into clear sections that answer the most important visitor questions. The final WordPress page explains the electrical work in plain language, connects benefits to real decisions and keeps contact options visible, making the project easier to read and trust.

fields.description_1: The ozturkmotionpictures website required better wedding information because it was important for people to get the offer before they contacted the company. fields.description_2: I rebuilt the page around clean sections, clear language, and practical WordPress content modules. The new structure helps visitors understand the project, see the value of the service, and find the next step without friction.

fields.description_1: Since the site failed to have accurate information on its pages, it became necessary that essential facts about the property be clearly visible right from the beginning. An effective introduction became important because it could assist in directing users into going through all the sections of the site easily while understanding the offer clearly.
fields.description_2: The design for Odetra was improved, with the usage of better English language, but still keeping the content organized. The page contains a clear description of the real estate services provided, no distractions whatsoever, the page allows quick comparison by visitors, and works perfectly on WordPress across all devices.

fields.description_1: It was necessary to narrow down the topics on which Marco Verhuurt could be discussed, since users cannot guess what kind of service the rental project provides. It required clear sections, specific language, and sufficient explanations to build trust without complicating the initial stage of contacting.
fields.description_2: The design of the last page focused on clear language, balanced parts, and contact opportunities that come up once there is sufficient background information for the user. It is easier to follow what must be done next in the process of renting, which makes the page more convincing for Marco Verhuurt. Contact used to matter more.

fields.description_1: For De Vrije Smid, the main challenge was to make the service offer clear within a few seconds. Visitors needed to understand which services are available, who they are meant for and why it is worth getting in touch.
fields.description_2: I improved the technical service story with a stronger introduction, clearer process steps and practical information linked to real use cases. The result is easier to scan on desktop and mobile, while still giving visitors enough detail to make contact with confidence.

fields.description_1: The biggest obstacle for Palmeroshop involved presenting the offer in a way that would be quickly understandable. This meant that the page needed to make clear what the offer included, who it served, and why contact should be initiated, without using generic phrases that could apply equally well to another site.
fields.description_2: I simplified the beauty story by adding an impactful introduction, defining services in clear sections, and putting practical information close to action points. The WordPress layout enables fast browsing, both on desktop and mobile devices, making it easy for visitors to comprehend the offer and choose to connect with Palmeroshop. This made a lot of sense.

fields.description_1: Woningontruiming Vergelijken needed more concise information, so visitors could understand the purpose of the comparison project without extra effort. The page needed clear sections, understandable wording, and enough detail to build trust without making the first contact step feel complicated.

The comparison message is clearer, supported by practical details at each decision point, and easier to use within both the portfolio case and the visitor journey.

fields.description_1: The Energy page for Solar Daktechnique entailed the removal of any sort of reservations before proceeding to inquire about anything. This visitor was likely comparing other firms, and therefore it was necessary to clarify what the firm had to offer and what steps followed thereafter. The use of general language would have caused confusion.

It not only enhances the presentation of Solar Daktechnique but also ensures that no visitor finds any difficulty browsing through the portfolio or contacting the company.

fields.description_1: Neutralhome needed content that was easier on the eyes and would make it easy to compare the various services available to them. What was needed was well-structured, clear content with appropriate wording that provided adequate information for building trust but did not make initial contact complicated.
fields.description_2: I created a clearer page structure with simple language, balanced sections, and contact moments placed where visitors are ready to act. The result is an education website that is easier to follow and more convincing for prospective students or parents.

fields.description_1: The website was in need for Marcosmontage due to certain issues. First of all, there should have been enough information provided about the offer regarding the exhibition. fields.description_1: YCO IT needed an offer that visitors could understand within a few seconds. The page had to explain the services, who they are for, and why someone should get in touch, without relying on broad phrases that could apply to almost any company.

Common questions are answered upfront, helping visitors understand what they are signing up for. Short explanations, persuasive copy, and clear call-to-action buttons make the application process more tangible.
